title: Aive Memory Clerk Corpus
subtitle: Contract-exact training data for The Aive's eight local memory clerks
description: Generated from the running memory layer in HereLiesAz/aive by MemoryDatasetGenerator. Each <role>.jsonl row has id, input (the rendered packet the runtime sends as the user turn), expected (the programmatic clerk's answer in the sections/nodes/links contract, verified to decode back to the clerk's batch), split (train/validation/test/adversarial) and tags. Each <role>.config.json carries the specialist ID, foundation model, system prompt and release gates. manifest.json records the source commit and SHA-256 of every file.
